project.name: Vidulum CashFlow API
project.description:
CONTRACT: what another module may ask of cashflow. No Spring, no HTTP, no implementation - the transport is chosen by whoever wires it, and the contract is the same either way.
Starts with one method, on purpose. It was derived from one real call site (GetStagingPreviewQueryHandler, which today loads the aggregate through DomainCashFlowRepository to read two fields), not from cashflow's public surface. The analysis behind it: docs/features-backlog/2026-10-16-cashflow-module-boundaries.md.
